summary.zh: 按食谱生成食材与购物清单
summary.en: Turn recipes into grocery shopping lists

description.zh: 把菜谱转成可购买的食材清单，搜索附近门店商品并返回价格。适合按食谱备料或日常补货。连接无需授权，下单仍在 Instacart 账号内完成。
description.en: Turn a recipe into a shoppable ingredient list, search nearby store products, and return prices. Useful for meal prep or restocking. No sign-in to connect; checkout still happens in your Instacart account.

authHint.zh: 无需授权，填好地址即可连接
authHint.en: No sign-in needed, connect with the URL
